notes: min_severity: info sends everything, notable skips the background, alert sends only what needs a look.
muted_kinds: silence one rule without touching the daemon, e.g. ["device_back_online", "new_peer"].
max_age_hours: do not deliver anything older than this, however long the spool has been unattended.
timezone is appended to the timestamp so it is unambiguous when read away from the box.
Run `netwatch-notify --config <this file> --explain` to see exactly what would be delivered.
